# Henrisol Properties Ltd — henrisol.oagroupng.com

Henrisol Properties Ltd is the real estate arm of OA Group Nigeria — a premium property company providing sales, lettings, investment advisory, property development, property management, and facilities management services across Nigeria.

## Company

- Type: Real estate and property services company
- Registered in Nigeria (CAC RC: [CAC: RC-XXXXXX])
- Address: 4, Aderoju Adewuyi Street, Off Alfred Olaiya Street, Opebi-Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 806 165 0349
- Email: info@henrisol.oagroupng.com
- Group: A Member of OA Group Nigeria (oagroupng.com)

## Services

- Sales & Lettings: residential and commercial property sales and lettings
- Real Estate Investment: structured investment opportunities for Nigerian and diaspora investors
- Property Development: end-to-end development management
- Property Management: tenant sourcing, rent collection, maintenance, reporting
- Facilities Management: PPM, reactive maintenance, vendor management, SLA-backed FM for corporates
- Diaspora Investment: remote-accessible investment structures for UK/US/Canada-based Nigerians

## Key Audiences

- Nigerian individuals buying or renting residential property
- Diaspora investors (UK, US, Canada) seeking Nigerian real estate
- Corporate office and commercial space seekers
- Institutional real estate investors
- Landlords seeking property management

## Cross-referral within OA Group

- Property financing available through Maria Oyinlola Limited (MOL) — mol.oagroupng.com
- Facilities management procurement support through Pearl Primus — pearlprimus.oagroupng.com
